basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old avid gamer based in Seattle, WA. I recently completed my bachelor's degree in computer science and am currently preparing to join the Air Force. My passion lies in gaming, especially Destiny 2, where I spend most of my free time diving deep into lore and perfecting my Guardian's look. I enjoy interacting with the community, sharing insights, and discussing game strategies. I'm currently single and usually online during the evenings after work. Apart from gaming, I have a keen interest in learning about different cultures and demographics, which often leads me to subreddits like Census.
